description: This file contains unit tests for POSIX thread-local storage (TLS) functionality, including creation, deletion, and destructor behavior of thread-specific data keys, using pthreads and Google Test framework.

classes.name: ThreadLocalValue
classes.description: Represents a thread-local value with a destroyed flag.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Holds context information for thread execution, including thread-specific key and values.

methods.name: DestroyThreadLocalValue
methods.description: Destructor function for thread-local values, sets destroyed flag to true.

methods.name: EntryPoint
methods.description: Thread entry point that sets and gets thread-specific data, checks if destroyed flag is set.

methods.name: ThreadEntryPoint
methods.description: Sets a thread-specific value to non-NULL and then to NULL, testing destructor behavior.

methods.name: DoSunnyDayTest
methods.description: Runs tests with multiple threads to verify thread-specific data and destructor invocation.

methods.name: CreateTLSKey_NoRecycle
methods.description: Creates a thread-specific key ensuring it is not recycled by the implementation.
